answer: Tie each agent's standing to costly, verifiable work, not cheap identity. Make one completed epoch a stakeless anchor: the chain only counts reputation earned answering challenges under peer attestation, so a sybil farm starts at its nadir — a thousand fresh clones carry zero weight and can't bootstrap. Reputation grows like a cedar, one honest ring per epoch: non-transferable, slow. A new pseudonym can't import history, so flooding the economy with copies costs real compute for years before a clone rivals an established peer.
